name: Google Maps Platform
summary: Places search and details (Places API New), forward and reverse geocoding, and Street View coverage lookups.

api_key.description: a Google Maps Platform API key from a Cloud project with billing and the Places API (New), Geocoding API and Street View Static API enabled (Google Cloud console > Google Maps Platform > Keys & Credentials)

notes: Billed per request by SKU, on a Cloud project with billing enabled; Places calls are billed by the most expensive field in the mask, so keep field masks short.
Places (New) calls need a field mask (the fields parameter); without one they fail.
Geocoding and Street View metadata answer HTTP 200 with a status field; read it.

endpoints.name: Search places by text
endpoints.summary: Places matching a text query such as 'pizza in New York', with the fields you ask for.

fields.description: Field mask, comma-separated with no spaces; required, there is no default. It sets the billing SKU, so ask only for what you need. '*' is all fields.

includedType.description: One place type from Table A to restrict to.

pageToken.description: nextPageToken from the previous response; every other parameter must be the same.

locationBias.description: {circle: {center: {latitude, longitude}, radius: metres up to 50000}} or {rectangle: {low, high}}. Not with locationRestriction.

locationRestriction.description: {rectangle: {low: {latitude, longitude}, high: {...}}}; results outside are dropped.

minRating.description: Minimum average rating, 0.0 to 5.0 in steps of 0.5.

regionCode.description: Two-character CLDR region code; affects formatting and biases results.

notes: At most 20 results per page and 60 across all pages.
Put nextPageToken in fields to be able to page.

endpoints.name: Search places near a point
endpoints.summary: Places of given types within a circle, ranked by popularity or distance.

fields.description: Field mask, comma-separated with no spaces; required, there is no default. It sets the billing SKU, so ask only for what you need. '*' is all fields.

locationRestriction.description: {circle: {center: {latitude, longitude}, radius: metres, above 0 and at most 50000}}.

includedTypes.description: Table A place types to include, up to 50.

excludedTypes.description: Table A place types to exclude, up to 50.

includedPrimaryTypes.description: Primary types to include, up to 50.

excludedPrimaryTypes.description: Primary types to exclude, up to 50.

regionCode.description: Two-character CLDR region code; affects formatting and biases results.

notes: A read over POST. No paging: at most 20 results.

endpoints.name: Get place details
endpoints.summary: One place by place id: name, address, location, hours, rating, website and any field in the mask.

fields.description: Field mask, comma-separated with no spaces; required, there is no default. It sets the billing SKU, so ask only for what you need. '*' is all fields.

sessionToken.description: The autocomplete session token this details call closes, for session billing.

notes: Reviews are a field of the details response (reviews), billed at the Enterprise + Atmosphere SKU.

endpoints.name: Geocode an address
endpoints.summary: Coordinates, place id and structured address components for an address.

address.description: The address to geocode; this or components is required.

components.description: Pipe-separated component:value filters that restrict results, e.g. 'country:GB|postal_code:SW1A'.

region.description: ccTLD-style region code to bias results.

notes: Errors come back as HTTP 200 with a status field: check status is OK (ZERO_RESULTS, OVER_QUERY_LIMIT, REQUEST_DENIED, INVALID_REQUEST).

endpoints.name: Reverse geocode coordinates
endpoints.summary: Addresses for a latitude/longitude, most precise first.

result_type.description: Pipe-separated address types to keep, e.g. 'street_address|locality'. A post-filter.

location_type.description: Pipe-separated: ROOFTOP, RANGE_INTERPOLATED, GEOMETRIC_CENTER, APPROXIMATE. A post-filter.

endpoints.name: Check Street View coverage
endpoints.summary: Whether a Street View panorama exists near a place, with its id, date and exact location. Free.

location.description: An address, 'lat,lng' or 'place_id:<id>'. This or pano is required.

notes: No charge and no quota for metadata; only loading the image is billed. The image itself is the Street View Static API (binary JPEG), not in this entry.
